answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 47023 Country: Canada Title: Purity of clothes in common Washing Machine Question: We live in Canada and have common washing machine on each floor of the apartment which is used by non-Muslims as well. Do the clothes become pure if we wash our clothes in this washing machine? The washing machine becomes dry after each run. Answer ID: 47023 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1106/845/D=9/1434) First, wash the washing machine with water thrice and then put your clothes in it for washing. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
